office: the Public Authority for Civil Information (PACI)

routes.label: through PACI, the fee payable on its website

note: Kuwait Times (30 March 2016), quoting PACI's director: the civil ID fee is KD 5, up from KD 2, and reissuing a lost or damaged card KD 20, payable online on PACI's website. No later change was found (the Government's e-services pages refuse this client). The card's term, the age at which it is due and the time weren't read.

sources.title: Kuwait Times, Civil ID fee raised from 'KD 2 to KD 5' (30 March 2016)
sources.said: KUWAIT: The Public Authority of Civil Information (PACI)’s director Musaed Al-Assoussi said that the new civil ID fees would be in effect from Sunday and that the fee would be KD 5 instead of KD 2. ... Al-Assoussi added that the decision includes increasing the fees re-issue in cases of loss or damage from KD 10 to 20. The civil ID fees could be paid online at the PACI’s website.
